# Cyril Lisle

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c25 P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c36 P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017)</sub>
- **Origin:** Portmaris  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P15](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0015)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038)</sub>

## Appearance

Cyril possesses endearing good looks and magnificent dark eyes. He has a lovely voice and is known for his signature dark, velvety smile.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036)_

## Personality

Cyril is intelligent, gentle, and highly romantic in his speech and courtship. However, he lacks humor, taking life and romance very seriously. Though sincere in his affections, he can be overly confident in his romantic pursuits and prone to dramatic declarations when rejected.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 c38 P19](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0019), [v3 c38 P27](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0027), [v3 c38 P45](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0045)_

## Goals

- to complete his Arts degree at Wexcombe  <sub>[v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038)</sub>
- to marry Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017)</sub>

## History

After returning from Europe to complete his Arts degree as a Junior at Wexcombe, Cyril met Nell Harcourt in a park during a rainstorm when his umbrella rescued hers. Impressed by her, he sent a dozen long-stemmed roses and a poem to her residence. Throughout their college years, he courted her with romantic gestures, sending her violets and sonnets for her birthday. He introduced his mother and sisters to the coeds at Tabby's Place, though he mistakenly gave them the wrong day for their arrival. Believing his feelings were fully reciprocated, Cyril proposed to Nell in the harbor park pavilion where they had first met. Upon her sudden rejection, he was crushed and bitter, expressing that his life was ruined before bidding her farewell. Afterward, he suffered dreadfully over the loss, though his sister Dorothy noted that he eventually recovers from heartbreaks.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036), [v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038), [v3 c25 P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 c25 P44](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0044), [v3 c25 P45](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0045), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c36 P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022), [v3 c36 P37](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0037), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 c38 P27](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0027), [v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032), [v3 c39 P4](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0004)_

## Background by volume

- father is deceased  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- belongs to the wealthy Gardner family of Portmaris  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c36 P19](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0019)</sub>
- completed his Freshman and Sophomore years at Wexcombe before traveling to Europe for two years due to his mother's health  <sub>[v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>

## Quotes

> I have the impression that I do not fit in anywhere so far. Two years back, I completed my Freshman and Sophomore years at Wexcombe. I have resided in Europe from that time onward. At present, I have returned so that I can complete my Arts degree.  <sub>[v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038)</sub>

> Your presence will soon be sought by my mother and sisters,  <sub>[v3 c36 P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017)</sub>

> Then you have merely been entertaining yourself throughout these past two years?  <sub>[v3 c38 P25](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0025)</sub>

> My life has been destroyed by you,  <sub>[v3 c38 P27](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0027)</sub>

> Well then—farewell, It is beyond my comprehension—it is impossible for me to accept that you aren't the lady I thought you were. However, upbraiding one another is useless now. No other female will ever have my affection. I am grateful to you for your companionship, if nothing else. Farewell, Nell.  <sub>[v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032)</sub>
